2609.30177.title: Search-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Component Query Understanding in Roblox Game Search
2609.30177.paper_summary: Query understanding (QU) plays a critical role in production search systems, translating raw user queries into search execution plans that drive downstream retrieval and ranking. While large language models (LLMs) have enabled QU to be framed as a structured multi-task generation problem (e.g., intent classification, query expansion), optimizing such models to produce search-engine-coupled outputs remains challenging: static, label-based supervision fails to capture how each component actually interacts with the underlying search pipeline to affect downstream performance. We present a search-aware reinforcement learning (RL) framework for QU based on a distill-then-RL paradigm. Teacher-student supervised fine-tuning (SFT) first yields a well-formed, schema-compliant policy initialization. The RL stage then optimizes each QU component with rewards derived from live interaction with the search engine, tailored to that component's operational role, rather than a single reward tied to the final search outcome. Experiments on Roblox search show that this component-specific optimization improves both per-component utility and downstream search quality, raising NDCG@20 by 8.9 points over the SFT policy and by 3.5 points over training with a single end-to-end reward.
2609.30177.paper_summary_zh: 查詢理解（QU）在生產搜索系統中扮演著關鍵角色，將原始用戶查詢轉換為推動下游檢索和排名的搜索執行計劃。雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）使得QU能夠被框架化為一個結構化的多任務生成問題（例如，意圖分類、查詢擴展），但優化這些模型以產生與搜索引擎相關的輸出仍然具有挑戰性：靜態的基於標籤的監督無法捕捉每個組件如何實際與基礎搜索管道互動以影響下游性能。我們提出了一個基於蒸餾-再強化學習（RL）範式的搜索感知強化學習框架來進行QU。教師-學生監督微調（SFT）首先產生一個格式良好、符合架構的策略初始化。然後，RL階段通過來自與搜索引擎的實時互動獲得的獎勵來優化每個QU組件，這些獎勵是根據該組件的操作角色量身定制的，而不是與最終搜索結果相關的單一獎勵。在Roblox搜索上的實驗顯示，這種針對組件的特定優化提高了每個組件的效用和下游搜索質量，使NDCG@20比SFT策略提高了8.9個點，比使用單一端到端獎勵的訓練提高了3.5個點。
